entities.summary: The Shankarpasha Shahi Jame Masjid,, Persian: شاهي مسجد شنكرپاشا), also known as the Uchail Mosque, is a 16th-century mosque, located in the Habiganj Sadar Upazila of Bangladesh. It is located in the village of Uchail Shankarpasha, Rajiura Union, Habiganj.
